title: AAPS 2.8.2.9-dev, Yellow Warning Triangle in Main Screen
symptom: Since updating to AAPS 2.8.2.9-dev build 2b021ffaf, a yellow warning triangle appears in the top left corner of the main screen with no information about its meaning. AAPS runs without any problem.
cause: The triangle is intended and reports BG data quality. Yellow means data must be recalculated to 5 min interval, red means there are BG duplicates preventing AAPS from running in closed loop mode.
fix: No fix needed; the triangle is informational. If red, see referenced issues for duplicates.
evidence_quote: there is new icon in 3.0-beta to report BG data quality. it looks like this. Yellow means data must be recalculated to 5 min interval, red means there are BG duplicates preventing AAPS from running in closed loop mode.
